provenance.post_title: Iconic Encounter: Out of the Dark
provenance.asset_description: Art by Pixoloid Studios. Iconic guardian, Grimmyr, a large, heavily armored, blue skinned humanoid known as a jotunborn. He swings a large battle hammer at a red skinned reptilian creature while a human villager hides behind him.
